# GitHub Copilot & VS Code Agent Instructions

## Domain Docs
- Read `CONTEXT.md` for domain terminology and pipeline structure.
- Read `docs/adr/` for architectural decision records.

## Graphify (Knowledge Graph)
- Consult `graphify-out/` before broad file searches.
- Use `graphify query "<question>"` or read `graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md` to trace architecture, god nodes, and correlations.
- Run `graphify update .` after making code modifications.
